info.name: CareSphere HIMS API
info.description: Run the login requests first; each saves its token for the rest. :key in GET URLs accepts a numeric id or a username.

item.name: 7. Patient appointments (patient's own)
item.description: Log in as a patient first (1. Logins > Patient login). Booking saves {{appointmentId}} for the cancel request. appointmentDateTime is local hospital time: 2026-10-20T10:30.

item.name: Book same slot again (run twice: expect an error the 2nd time)
8. Patient documents (patient's own)
item.description: Upload is multipart/form-data: text fields documentName, documentType (Clinical | Surgical | Prescription | Report), documentSource (Present | Past, default Present) and the file in a field named "file" (Type = File). Allowed: pdf, jpg, png, max 5 MB. Upload saves {{documentId}}. Use 'Send and Download' on the download request.

formdata.description: Select a .html/.txt file to see the 422

item.name: 9. User management (SuperAdmin)
item.description: Run SuperAdmin login first. Set {{targetUserId}} to the users.id to manage (never your own id for deactivate/lock/delete).

item.name: 10. Doctor availability
item.description: View: any signed-in user. Create/update/delete: SuperAdmin or Admin. dayOfWeek Monday..Sunday, times HH:mm (24h). Create saves {{availabilityId}}.
